import sys

N = int(input())
A = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(N)]

# prefix sums for quick range sum
pref = [[0]*(N+1) for _ in range(N+1)]
for i in range(N):
    row_sum = 0
    for j in range(N):
        row_sum += A[i][j]
        pref[i+1][j+1] = pref[i][j+1] + row_sum

def rect_sum(x1, y1, x2, y2):
    # sum over rows x1..x2, cols y1..y2 inclusive
    return (pref[x2+1][y2+1] - pref[x1][y2+1] - pref[x2+1][y1] + pref[x1][y1])

# cost[l][r] = sum A[i][j] for l <= i < j <= r
cost = [[0]*N for _ in range(N)]
for l in range(N):
    for r in range(l, N):
        cost[l][r] = rect_sum(l, l+1, r, r)

INF = 10**18
dp = [INF]*N
for r in range(N):
    # entire segment 0..r
    dp[r] = cost[0][r]
    for l in range(1, r+1):
        dp[r] = min(dp[r], dp[l-1] + cost[l][r])

print(dp[N-1])

import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.readline
    N = int(input())
    A = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(N)]

    # Key observation:
    # Let p[v] = v. For every original edge i->i+1 with weight 0:
    #   0 + p[i] - p[i+1] = -1 <= 0
    # so all original edges satisfy reduced-cost nonnegativity condition.
    #
    # For added edges:
    # - if i < j, weight = -1, and
    #   -1 + p[i] - p[j] = -1 + i - j < 0
    #   so such an edge can never be kept in any graph without negative cycle.
    #   Therefore all i<j added edges must be deleted.
    #
    # - if i > j, weight = 1, and
    #   1 + p[i] - p[j] = 1 + i - j > 0
    #   so these edges are always safe to keep.
    #
    # Hence the minimum cost is simply the sum of deletion costs of all added
    # forward edges (i, j) with i < j.
    #
    # Input includes A[i][i] too, but edges with i == j are not added.

    ans = 0
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(i + 1, N):
            ans += A[i][j]

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
